name: stool
description: Claude Code mods in one plugin: plan-progress bars and usage strip, agent cap, keep-warm, restart tools, agent meter, and opt-in dispatch, lead and capture guards, plus a set of workflow skills.

projectRoots.title: Project folders
projectRoots.description: Folders (with their subfolders) where the folder-scoped parts run: keep-warm, agent-meter, and the opt-in guards. Empty = every folder

doneBarSeconds.title: Finished bar stays (seconds)
doneBarSeconds.description: Seconds a finished progress bar stays above the prompt while auto-close (/plan-progress-autoclose) is on

twinkle.title: Twinkle the terminal bar
twinkle.description: Animate the dots of the terminal progress bar while Claude works. Off, they are drawn still

keepWarm.title: Keep-warm
keepWarm.description: Ping a big idle session every 50 minutes so its prompt cache stays warm (/keepwarm off|on|<count> per session)

slotFile.title: Agent slot file
slotFile.description: File shared by every session that counts the running agents against the agent cap (dispatch guard writes it, the usage strip reads it). ~ is your home folder

agentLedger.title: Agent ledger file
agentLedger.description: Tab-separated file with one line per finished subagent (calls, tokens, seconds, cap). ~ is your home folder

restartContextAt.title: Restart due at context %
restartContextAt.description: The restart clock says a restart is due when the main conversation reaches this context percent

leadGuard.title: Lead guard
leadGuard.description: Deny the main conversation known slips: git add -A, cd out of the project folder, shell writes to the doc paths below, check scripts piped to tail. Subagents are not guarded

leadGuardDocPaths.title: Lead guard: doc paths
leadGuardDocPaths.description: Regex source: shell writes (sed -i, redirects, node -e writes) to paths matching it are denied. Empty turns the rule off

leadGuardCheckScripts.title: Lead guard: check scripts
leadGuardCheckScripts.description: Regex source for scripts whose output must not be piped through tail/head without pipefail. Empty turns the rule off

leadGuardImageNudge.title: Lead guard: image-read nudge
leadGuardImageNudge.description: Remind the main conversation to hand image checks to a cheaper subagent after its 3rd full-size image read

dispatchGuard.title: Dispatch guard
dispatchGuard.description: Append standing orders to every Agent prompt, require a tool-call cap on prompts matching the cap pattern, and hold Sonnet/Opus-class agents to the agent cap across sessions

dispatchOrders.title: Dispatch guard: standing orders
dispatchOrders.description: Lines (one per line, each starting with "- ") appended to every Agent prompt, before a tool-call cap line
dispatchOrders.default:
- Edit only the files this prompt assigns to you.
- Keep your report short.

dispatchCapPattern.title: Dispatch guard: cap pattern
dispatchCapPattern.description: Regex source (case-insensitive). A prompt matching it must state a tool-call cap or the spawn is denied, and it also gets the extra orders below. Empty turns the rule off

dispatchCapOrders.title: Dispatch guard: extra orders
dispatchCapOrders.description: Lines appended to prompts that match the cap pattern

dispatchCheapAgents.title: Dispatch guard: cheap agent types
dispatchCheapAgents.description: Subagent types not counted against the agent cap (any Haiku-model agent is never counted)

captureGuard.title: Capture guard
captureGuard.description: Stop a subagent (or the main conversation) after two slow capture-tool calls in a row, and show free RAM and app windows on the usage strip. Needs the two fields below

captureTool.title: Capture guard: tool name
captureTool.description: Full tool name to watch, e.g. mcp__server__screen_capture. Empty = no breaker

captureProcess.title: Capture guard: process name
captureProcess.description: Windows process name counted for the strip (no .exe). Empty = no strip value

restartPublishCounter.title: Restart clock: publish counter
restartPublishCounter.description: Count commands matching the pattern below; the restart clock says a restart is due after the count below since the handoff file was last rewritten

restartPublishPattern.title: Restart clock: publish pattern
restartPublishPattern.description: Regex source for the commands to count (a deploy or publish script). Empty = counter off

restartPublishesAt.title: Restart clock: publishes before a restart
restartPublishesAt.description: Count at which a restart is due

restartHandoffLint.title: Restart clock: handoff lint
restartHandoffLint.description: Warn when a write to the handoff file leaves two heading blocks or a stale "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MMZ" time

restartHandoffFile.title: Restart clock: handoff file name
restartHandoffFile.description: File name the lint and the counter reset watch

restartHandoffHeading.title: Restart clock: handoff heading
restartHandoffHeading.description: Text after "## " of the block that is rewritten on each restart

restartRewriteCommand.title: Restart clock: rewrite command
restartRewriteCommand.description: Regex source for a shell command that rewrites the handoff block (resets the counter, like an Edit or Write of it). Empty = none
